output.title: Breaking HTTP01 Ingress PathType change may affect challenge solving
output.content: v1.18.0 changes the PathType for ACME HTTP01 Ingress-based challenges to Exact, flagged as a breaking change that is incompatible with certain setups. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources and sets global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, but the summary does not show whether HTTP01 Ingress solvers are configured. Inspect your issuers for HTTP01 Ingress solvers, the value of global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, and whether your Ingress controller handles PathType Exact.
